action_input.sql:
SELECT
  T3.power_name
FROM 'json/superhero.json' AS T1
INNER JOIN 'csv/hero_power.csv' AS T2
  ON T1.id = T2.hero_id
INNER JOIN 'csv/superpower.csv' AS T3
  ON T2.power_id = T3.id
WHERE
  T1.superhero_name = '3-D Man';

steps.thought: The JSON file `json/superhero.json` has a `records` array. I need to unnest this array to access the superhero data. I will modify the DuckDB SQL query to use `read_json_auto` and `UNNEST` the `records` array to correctly extract the `id` and `superhero_name`.

action_input.sql:
SELECT
  T4.power_name
FROM (SELECT unnest(records) as T1 FROM read_json_auto('json/superhero.json')) AS superhero_unnested
INNER JOIN 'csv/hero_power.csv' AS T2
  ON superhero_unnested.T1.id = T2.hero_id
INNER JOIN 'csv/superpower.csv' AS T4
  ON T2.power_id = T4.id
WHERE
  superhero_unnested.T1.superhero_name = '3-D Man';
